Anamnesi prossima: in data 21/07 comparsa di rash cutaneo al volto dopo assunzione di amoxicillina. All¿¿¿ingresso in reparto si presentava emodinamicamente stabile senza supporti farmacologici ed eupnoico in ossigenoterapia 3 L/min. Esami ematici: troponina 50 pg/mL. TC torace negativa per linfoadenopatie mediastiniche. Avevamo programmato RMN cardiaca con mdc che il paziente ha rifiutato. All'ECG riscontro di FA ad elevata FVM, cardiovertita con metoprololo ev. 3.  **Segmental wall motion abnormalities**: The text reports "ipocinesia del setto posteriore medio basale e della parete inferiore medio basale" (hypokinesia of the mid-basal posterior septum and mid-basal inferior wall). This constitutes segmental wall motion abnormalities.
4.  **New focal or diffuse left or right ventricular function abnormalities**: The text reports "FE ai limiti inferiori" (ejection fraction at lower limits). Reduced ejection fraction is a functional abnormality of the left ventricle. Given the context of suspected myocarditis and the presence of wall motion abnormalities, this represents a functional defect consistent with the criteria for "New focal or diffuse... function abnormalities".
5.  **Pericardial effusion/inflammation**: The text states "non versamento pericardico" (no pericardial effusion). While hyperechogenicity is an imaging finding of potential inflammation, the primary confirmed findings are functional and motion-related. But typically, in these validation tasks, unless "pericarditis" is explicitly confirmed or significant effusion is present, we focus on the myocardial findings for myocarditis criteria.
